about: Every number on these slides, with its source. All examples use example data. Live facts were read from public, read-only endpoints on October 30, 2026 at 07:09 UTC, after Teleion Fabric's redeploy at 06:53 UTC and Eranos's at 06:55 UTC; nothing that changes state was called, and no request was sent.

claims.number: Typed requests on the site: one box, live since October 30, 2026 at 06:55 UTC
claims.source: Eranos pull request 11, deployed at 06:55 UTC on October 30, 2026, added one box, Tell us what you need, at /nonprofits. A GET at 07:09 UTC returned the page and its page Task Object with that title. Sending signs the organization up for its own narrow key and files the request as one Task on eq01; this check sent nothing.

claims.number: Sign-up and the request box, live since October 30, 2026 at 06:55 UTC
claims.source: Teleion Fabric's access contract at 07:09 UTC lists self-serve requester keys as enabled, at POST /v1/session/requester: a key that writes only in its organization's own org. stores, files requests only on eq01 and reads only what it filed. Eranos pull request 11, deployed at 06:55 UTC on October 30, 2026, signs an organization up when it sends its first request from /nonprofits. This check signed up for nothing.

claims.number: Open contribution, live since Teleion Fabric's redeploy on October 30, 2026 at 06:53 UTC
claims.source: Teleion Fabric's access contract at 07:09 UTC: a tracked anonymous session may claim, heartbeat and submit Tasks tagged open:anonymous in the main namespace; the review queue eq03 stays closed to it, and its results wait for a different keyed reviewer. Teleion Fabric pull request 21, deployed at 06:53 UTC. Eranos's help page says no key is needed to start. This check claimed nothing.

claims.number: 14 example kits pass build, check and review on a desktop computer
claims.source: Eranos's /api/examples at 07:09 UTC: 14 recorded example runs on a desktop computer, with example data and 0 model calls, each ending published to a local catalog after building, checking and an independent review, recorded at 04:31 UTC on October 30, 2026. Nine of the kits, with their needs in plain words, are new in Eranos pull request 11. No hosted volunteer run is claimed.
Eranos's /api/catalog at 07:09 UTC listed KIT-RECRUIT-01 to KIT-SHIFT-05, while the copy built into the site holds all 14.

claims.source: Eranos pull request 11, deployed at 06:55 UTC on October 30, 2026: sending a first request from /nonprofits gets the organization its own narrow key, from Teleion Fabric's self-serve requester sign-up, which its access contract listed as enabled at 07:09 UTC. claims.number: An open task needs no key, since Teleion Fabric's redeploy on October 30, 2026 at 06:53 UTC
claims.source: Teleion Fabric's access contract at 07:09 UTC: a tracked anonymous session, opened without secrets, may claim Tasks tagged open:anonymous, at most 5 open claims an hour, and a different keyed worker or a person reviews its results. Reviewing and publishing still need a scoped key. This check claimed nothing.

claims.source: Eranos pull request 11, deployed at 06:55 UTC on October 30, 2026. A request from the box is kept as a Task Object in the organization's own space in Teleion Fabric and files one Task on eq01. A GET at 07:09 UTC returned the page; this check sent nothing.
